page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-2x.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores powered by the AMD EPYC 9A75 processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU configuration allocates exactly one thread per core, providing dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

This instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 6.0 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is driven by two integrated NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, which deliver a combined total of 144 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

The hardware profile represents a high-density accelerator class designed for parallel processing workloads. By pairing dedicated AMD EPYC cores with NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, the instance balances host-side execution with massive GPU compute capacity. This configuration is engineered for workloads such as machine learning model training, large-scale inference, data science pipelines, and complex parallel simulations that require high-bandwidth networking and substantial graphics memory without relying on local disk storage.
